📖 How to use

  1. Fill in title, author, finish date and rating.
  2. Click Log Book.
  3. See your yearly total and average rating at the top.
  4. Delete entries you added by mistake.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I log a book?

Enter the title, author, the date you finished, and a 1–5 star rating, then click Log Book.

How is the yearly count calculated?

The yearly count card uses the finished date — it counts books logged with a finish date in the current calendar year.

How do I rate a book?

Click the stars before logging. The stars row defaults to 0 (no rating) — tap a star to set 1–5.

Is my book log saved?

Yes, in this browser's localStorage. Your log stays private on this device.
